name: MAG 7 Daily
description: MAG 7 Daily follows seven companies — Alphabet, Amazon, Apple, Meta Platforms, Microsoft, NVIDIA and Tesla — as one desk. Every day: the products, models and chips they shipped, the research they published, the rulings and deals that change what they can do, the strongest counterpoint to the day's story, and one thread that runs across several of them. Developments and numbers, never picks. Not financial advice.
